purpose: Retailer/method authorization state. The shopping skill reads this file and fails closed for any browser method without an entry. Reading a retailer's own API through a Printing Press client needs no entry.

statuses.AUTHORIZED: A recorded method exists for the specific retailer and method.
statuses.PUBLIC_OFFICIAL_API: A retailer-published official API permits the operation under its license.
statuses.MANUAL_ONLY: Only manual user operation (site or app) is permitted; no automated collection.
statuses.BLOCKED_PENDING_AUTHORIZATION: A browser method with no recorded entry; it is refused until one is recorded.
statuses.RETIRED: No supported route; not a candidate for automation.
